text: When one generator needs to produce values from another, yield from makes it effortless.
Instead of looping and yielding each item by hand, yield from streams an entire generator straight through.
Here combined yields all the letters, then all the numbers, as one seamless sequence.
[chuckle] It's like splicing several generators together into a single flat stream of values.
[sniff] yield from truly shines with recursion, like flattening a deeply nested list.
When flatten hits a sublist, it recursively delegates to itself with yield from.
Each nested level streams its values up through the chain, no matter how deep the nesting goes.
[sigh] So a tangled structure of lists within lists comes out as one clean, flat sequence.
[groan] yield from turns awkward nested generator loops into a single, expressive line.
